DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金する金額はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided how much to deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分のお金を入れたいのですが、友人から預かった買い物代も同じ封筒に入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預かった現金と自分のお金が混ざったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to deposit my own money, but I put some shopping money a friend entrusted to me in the same envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the cash entrusted to you got mixed with your own money. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの金額が分かる記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a record showing each amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の分は五千円とメッセージにあります。封筒全体は一万二千円ですが、自分の残額を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 総額と友人分の記録を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: A message says my friend's share is 5,000 yen. The envelope contains 12,000 yen in total, but I haven't checked how much of my own money is left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the total and the record of your friend's share. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず記録と現金を照合してください。こちらでは、そのお金の所有者を判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First compare the record with the cash. We cannot determine who owns that money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人の五千円を分けてから、自分の分が七千円か記録も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録と現金を照合して自分の分を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll separate my friend's 5,000 yen, then check the record as well to see whether my share is 7,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the record with the cash to confirm your share. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できない場合は、急いで全部を入金せず、持ち主と金額を確かめてからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you cannot confirm it, don't rush to deposit everything. Check who owns it and how much it is first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は自分の分だけ入れる予定でした。記録が合うまで入金操作は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認前に入金操作をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only planned to deposit my own share today. I won't start the deposit process until the record matches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not start the deposit before checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 数える場合はこちらの確認スペースをお使いください。周囲に置き忘れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need to count it, please use this checking area. Please make sure you don't leave anything behind nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二つの封筒に分け、確認できた自分の金額だけで改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した金額を別の封筒に分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll separate it into two envelopes and come back to ask about depositing only the amount confirmed as mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the confirmed amount into another envelope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認スペースはこちらです。準備ができましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The checking area is here. Please let us know when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の惣菜ができました。番号札をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your prepared food order is ready. Please show me your number ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。札をもらったので、もう支払いも済んだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文札を支払い済みと誤解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. Since I received a ticket, I thought I had already paid too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook the order ticket for proof of payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この札は注文番号です。お会計はまだで、商品を受け取ってからレジでお支払いいただく設定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This ticket is your order number. You haven't paid yet; the arrangement is to pay at the register after collecting the items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。売場ではお金を渡していません。札だけ持って出口へ行くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだお金を渡していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I haven't handed over any money at the counter. I was about to head for the exit with just the ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not handed over any money yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取った商品には価格ラベルがあります。ほかの買い物と一緒にレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The items you collect have price labels. Please take them to the register with your other shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一緒に来た友人の分も注文しました。商品を分けて、それぞれ支払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人分と自分分を別会計にできるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also ordered for the friend who came with me. Can you separate the items so we can each pay separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend's items and yours can be paid for separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの商品にラベルがありますので、袋を分けます。どの商品がどなたの分か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Each item has its own label, so I'll put them in separate bags. Please confirm which items belong to whom.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私はこちらの二個、友人はもう一個です。受け取り時に数を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: それぞれの商品と数量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: These two are mine, and the other one is my friend's. I'll check the quantities when we collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate each person's items and quantities. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、そのように袋を分けます。番号札はこちらで回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll bag them that way. I'll collect the number ticket here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。札は注文のためのもの、支払いは価格ラベル付きの商品を持ってレジでするのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文札と会計に使う価格ラベルの役割を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. So the ticket is for the order, and payment is made at the register with the price-labeled items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the roles of the order ticket and the price labels used for payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。商品はこちらです。数量をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's right. Here are your items. Please check the quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 排水口のところで何か引っ掛かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something caught at the drain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私たちの敷いていた紙が飛ばされました。取りにくいので、中へ押し込めば片付くかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飛んだ紙が排水口に引っ掛かったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The paper we had spread out blew away. It was hard to retrieve, so I thought pushing it inside would clear it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the paper blew away and got caught in the drain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中へ押し込まず、いったん離れてください。蓋もご自身で外さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't push it inside; step away for now. Don't remove the cover yourself either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。見える端だけ引っ張ろうとしましたが、途中で破れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 押し込む作業を止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I tried pulling just the visible edge, but it tore partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will stop pushing it in. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの辺りまで破れて、中に残ったか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know how much tore off and what is still inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 角の一部だけ取れました。大きい部分はまだ入口に引っ掛かっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取れた部分と残った部分を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only part of a corner came off. The large section is still caught at the opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain which part came off and which part remains. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 残った部分は担当者が確認します。取れた紙は飛ばないよう袋へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff responsible will check the remaining section. Put the paper you retrieved in a bag so it won't blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。袋の口を閉じます。残りの敷物も重しを外す前に畳みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収した紙と残りの敷物を風で飛ばないよう片付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll close the bag. I'll also fold the remaining sheets before removing their weights.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put away the retrieved paper and remaining sheets so they cannot blow away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。風が強いので、軽い物を広げたままにしないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. The wind is strong, so please don't leave lightweight things spread out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで食べるのは切り上げ、荷物をまとめます。残った紙の場所はこの排水口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残った紙の位置を伝え利用を切り上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll stop eating here and pack our belongings. The remaining paper is in this drain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate where the remaining paper is and say you will finish using the area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所を確認しました。回収は担当者に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed the location. I'll pass the retrieval on to the staff responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族と別々に改札を通る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to go through the ticket gates separately from your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二人分の券が私の携帯にあります。妻は先に移動するので、画面の写真を送れば使えるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の電子券が自分の端末にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Both tickets are on my phone. My wife is leaving first, so I'd like to know whether she can use a photo of the screen if I send one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that both electronic tickets are on your device. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券の種類ごとに利用方法を確認しましょう。写真にした表示をそのまま使えるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the usage method for each ticket type. A photographed display cannot necessarily be used as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ写真は送っていません。妻の分を妻の端末へ渡せる方法があるか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真ではなく正式な受け渡し方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't sent a photo yet. I'd like to check whether there is a way to transfer my wife's ticket to her device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the official transfer method instead of a photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の券では、利用前に公式の受け渡し操作を行います。両方の端末で表示を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the tickets in this learning material, perform the official transfer procedure before use. Check the displays on both devices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。受け渡しが完了するまでは、私の端末から勝手に削除しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 完了前に券を削除しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't delete the ticket from my device on my own before the transfer is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not delete the ticket before completion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け渡し後に、ご本人の券がどちらにあるかも確認してください。二人とも同じ券を開かないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After transferring it, also check where your own ticket is. Make sure you don't both open the same ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の券と妻の券を区別して、妻の画面に自分の分が出ることを確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の端末でそれぞれの券を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll distinguish my ticket from my wife's and make sure her own ticket appears on her screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish and check each person's ticket on the two devices. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 操作ができない場合は、二人そろって窓口へ戻ってください。改札を通ってから別れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you cannot complete the operation, come back to the counter together. Please don't split up after going through the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。使える表示を二人とも確認してから、別々に出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自の利用可能な表示を確認後に別行動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. We'll leave separately after both of us have confirmed a usable display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will travel separately after each person checks their usable display. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受け渡し操作の案内はこちらです。必要でしたら窓口で一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The transfer instructions are here. If needed, we can check them together at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書のご記入で、お手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help filling out the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手をけがして、長く書けません。家族に住所などを書いてもらいたいのですが、名前も全部任せてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: けがのため家族による記入補助を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I injured my hand and can't write for long. I'd like my family to write things like my address, but can I leave my name entirely to them too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about help from your family with writing because of your injury. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記入の補助と、本人の意思を確認する部分を分けて担当者に確認します。申請内容はご本人が確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person responsible, distinguishing assistance with writing from the part confirming your own wishes. Can you check the application contents yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。内容は読み上げてもらえば確認できます。家族が私の署名をまねることは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で内容を確認でき署名をまねさせたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I can check them if someone reads them aloud. I'd like to avoid having my family imitate my signature.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can check the contents yourself and do not want your signature imitated. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を承ります。住所などの記入を補助してもらい、署名欄はまだ空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll pass on that preference. Have them help fill in things like your address, and leave the signature field blank for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。署名の代わりに使える方法があるか、担当者から説明を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 署名欄を空けて代替方法の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'd like the person responsible to explain whether there is an alternative to a signature.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the signature field blank and request an explanation of alternatives. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのような方法で意思確認するか、この申請について確認します。先に代理人として提出したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check how your wishes can be confirmed for this application. We won't treat it as already submitted by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本人はここにいます。家族は内容を決めるのではなく、書く作業を助けるだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が同席し家族は記入だけを助けると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I am here in person. My family is only helping with the writing, not deciding the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are present and your family is only helping fill in the form. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、記入補助が必要なことと、ご本人が内容を確認することを引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll pass on that you need help writing and that you will check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。住所の記載を確認し、署名欄は説明を聞いてから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補助された記載を確認し署名は説明後に進めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the written address and proceed with the signature field after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the assisted entries and proceed with the signature after the explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へご案内します。お二人でこちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the person responsible. Please both come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お迎えの方は、もう到着していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has the person picking you up arrived yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。借りた車椅子を先に返すと、外で立って待つことになるので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えが未到着で返却後に立って待つ不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I'd like to ask about returning the borrowed wheelchair first, because then I'd have to stand outside waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your ride has not arrived and you are concerned about standing to wait after returning the wheelchair. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車が到着するまで、院内の待機場所でお待ちいただけるよう担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person responsible so you can wait in an indoor waiting area until the car arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。車に移った後で家族が椅子を戻してもよいか、返却場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車への移動後の返却方法と場所を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I'd also like to know whether my family can return the chair after I transfer into the car, and where to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how and where to return it after moving into the car. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出担当に返却方法を確認します。乗り移る際の介助が必要かも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the return procedure with the lending staff. Please also tell me whether you need help transferring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で急いで移るのは不安です。家族だけでよいかも含めて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗り移る際の介助を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm nervous about transferring quickly on my own. I'd like to check whether help from just my family is enough too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about assistance when transferring. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診療担当者に必要な介助を確認します。車の到着連絡を受けるまでは、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with your care team what assistance you need. Please stay where you are until you receive word that the car has arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。運転する家族には、到着したらまず連絡し、指定の乗車場所を確認するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に到着連絡と乗車場所の確認を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll tell the family member driving to contact us first on arrival and check the designated pickup location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your family to report their arrival and confirm the pickup location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者から待機場所、乗車の介助、車椅子の返却をまとめてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will explain the waiting area, help getting into the car, and wheelchair return together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。返すことだけを先に決めず、車への移動と返却の順番を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動の介助と返却の順番をまとめて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Instead of deciding only the return first, I'll check the order for moving into the car and returning the chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check transfer assistance and the return sequence together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの待機席でお待ちください。担当者に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait in these seats. I'll contact the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出来事について、映像をお持ちなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have footage of the incident, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、私が撮ったものではありません。店の方が防犯映像の一部を私へ送ってくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参映像は店舗から受け取った一部だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I didn't record it. Someone at the shop sent me part of their security footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the footage you brought is an excerpt received from the shop. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の映像を管理しているのは、その店舗ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that shop responsible for managing the original footage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。私の携帯には短い部分だけあります。時刻の表示も、店の時計が正しいかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元データの管理者と時刻の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I only have a short section on my phone. As for the displayed time, I don't know whether the shop's clock was correct either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State who manages the original data and that the time is unverified. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身が見たことと、映像で後から見たことを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish what you saw yourself from what you saw later in the footage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は入口で二人が話すのを見ました。片方が裏口へ行ったことは、後で映像を見て知りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接見た事実と後から映像で見たことを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw two people talking at the entrance. I only learned later from the footage that one of them went to the back door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish what you witnessed directly from what you saw later in the footage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いを記録します。店舗への確認や資料の扱いは、担当者からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record that distinction. The person responsible will explain contacting the shop and handling the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。私のファイルを元の全映像として渡さず、店の連絡先も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 映像の範囲と店舗の連絡先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't present my file as the complete original footage, and I'll provide the shop's contact details too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the scope of the footage and the shop's contact details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 映像を加工したり、さらに周囲へ送ったりせず、その状態で担当者にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the person responsible with the footage as it is, without editing it or sending it on to others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の目撃内容、受け取った短い映像、元データを持つ店舗を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 加工や拡散をせず資料の出所を整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll explain separately what I witnessed, the short footage I received, and the shop holding the original data.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the material's origin without editing or spreading it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that information on to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの袋の内側の箱は、ぬれているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The box inside this bag is wet, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨に当たりました。乾いた袋をかぶせたので、このまま送れるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨でぬれた箱を袋で覆ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It got caught in the rain. I put a dry bag over it, so I thought I could send it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you covered the rain-soaked box with a bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側を覆っただけでは、中身の状態は分かりません。箱の中に何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Covering only the outside doesn't tell us the condition of the contents. What's inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の資料です。角まで水が染みたかは、開けていないので分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙の資料のぬれ方が未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Paper documents. I haven't opened it, so I don't know whether water soaked all the way to the corners.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the extent of water damage to the paper documents is unconfirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で中身を確認し、送ってよい状態かを確かめてください。ぬれた箱を隠したまま受付は進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contents yourself and make sure they're in a condition suitable for sending. We won't proceed with acceptance while the wet box remains concealed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。受取人に原本が必要か聞き、内容を確かめてから梱包し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身を確認し受取人に原本の要否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll ask the recipient whether they need the originals, check the contents, and then repack them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the contents and ask the recipient whether the originals are needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先のラベルも水で読みにくくなっています。新しい外装に、確認できる宛先を記載してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The address label has also become hard to read from the water. Write a verifiable destination on the new outer packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。古いラベルをそのまま転記せず、受取人の住所と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読みにくい古いラベルを住所と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't just copy the old label; I'll compare it with the recipient's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the hard-to-read old label with the address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱を替える場合は、中の資料の枚数も確認してから閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you replace the box, also check the number of documents inside before closing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。資料の状態と枚数、宛先を確認し、乾いた外装へ入れて改めて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容と宛先を確認して再梱包後に持ち込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the documents' condition and number and the destination, put them in dry packaging, and bring them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the contents and destination, repack, and bring it back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備後に、外装と発送方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you're ready, we'll check the outer packaging and shipping method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りの金額はご確認いただけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked the amount you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。後ろの人が待っているので、通路で全部広げて数えようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混雑のため通路で数えようとしていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. People behind me are waiting, so I was going to spread it all out in the passage and count it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were going to count in the passage because it is crowded. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならない確認スペースをご案内します。現金をまとめてから移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll show you a checking area where you won't block people passing. Gather the cash together before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。封筒の中に前から入っていたお金もあるので、混ぜずに数えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参現金と今回の出金を混ぜず確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. There's also money that was already in my envelope, so I'd like to count without mixing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to check your cash and this withdrawal without mixing them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回お渡しした現金と、ご自身の持参分を分けて確認してください。今回の出金額はこちらの明細です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the cash we just handed you separately from what you brought. This slip shows this withdrawal amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明細は二万円です。受け取った束はそのまま別の場所に置き、持参分は封筒に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明細の額と確認する現金を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The slip says 20,000 yen. I'll place the bundle I received separately as it is and leave my own cash in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the amount on the slip and the cash to be checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数えた後、明細と合うか確認し、もし違うと感じたらその場で係員にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After counting, check whether it matches the slip. If you think there is a discrepancy, tell a staff member there and then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。自分の財布へ入れてから全体を数えるのではなく、今回の分だけ先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の現金を財布へ混ぜる前に照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll check just this withdrawal first, rather than putting it in my wallet and counting everything together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will compare this cash before mixing it into your wallet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が終わりましたら、現金と明細を置き忘れないようおしまいください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you're finished checking, put the cash and slip away so you don't leave them behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。指定の場所で二万円を確認し、明細も持って退出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額確認後に現金と明細を収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the 20,000 yen in the designated area and take the slip with me when I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put away the cash and slip after checking the amount. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認スペースはこちらです。必要なときは近くの係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The checking area is here. Please speak to a nearby staff member if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 氷をご利用になりますか。専用の袋はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use ice? The bags for it are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷凍食品があるので、氷を商品の袋へ直接入れようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷却の氷を商品の袋へ直接入れようとしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have frozen food, so I was going to put ice directly into the bag with the products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were going to put cooling ice directly in the product bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 氷は専用の袋に入れて口を閉じ、商品がぬれないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Put the ice in its designated bag and close it so the products don't get wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。これは食べるための氷として売っている商品ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷却用と食用の氷を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. So this isn't a product sold as ice for eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish cooling ice from edible ice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では持ち帰り時の冷却用です。飲み物に入れる氷は、売場の食品表示のある商品を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this learning material, it is for cooling on the way home. For ice to put in drinks, choose a product from the sales floor with food labeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は冷却だけに使います。帰宅まで一時間かかりますが、氷を入れれば必ず品質が保てるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰り時間と品質の保証を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use it only for cooling today. It takes an hour to get home, but I won't assume adding ice will necessarily preserve the quality.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the journey time from a guarantee of quality. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の保存表示と持ち帰り時間もご確認ください。保冷バッグもお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the product's storage instructions and your journey time. Do you have an insulated bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。袋を閉じた氷と食品を入れ、帰ったら商品を表示どおり保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保冷バッグの使用と帰宅後の保存を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. I'll put the sealed bag of ice and the food in it, and store the products as labeled when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use an insulated bag and follow storage instructions at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で氷が解けることもありますので、袋の口をしっかり閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ice may melt on the way, so please close the bag securely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。冷却用の氷を食品として使わず、ぬれないように包んで保冷バッグへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氷を密封して商品がぬれないよう持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't use the cooling ice as food. I'll wrap it so the products don't get wet and put it in the insulated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will seal the ice and take the products home without getting them wet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 専用袋はこちらです。商品の保存表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The designated bags are here. Please check the products' storage instructions too.
